login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Use the work email and password your hospital admin gave you. Patients use the Wasla app.
login.sideTitle: Every visit, from the front desk to the result.
login.sideBody: Check patients in, run the queue, and follow each visit as it moves through the clinic.

shell.noRoleScreens: There are no screens for your role on this website yet.

reception.title: Today's appointments
reception.summary: {{booked}} to arrive · {{waiting}} waiting · {{withDoctor}} with doctor · {{done}} done
reception.noClinics: You aren't assigned to a clinic yet. Ask your hospital admin to add you to one.
reception.noAppointments: No appointments in this clinic today.

queue.title: Queue
queue.nobodyWithDoctor: Nobody is with the doctor right now.

errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some fields are invalid. Check them and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Log in again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: That record wasn't found. It may have been removed.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That email and password don't match an active staff account.
errors.PHONE_NOT_VERIFIED: This phone number hasn't been verified yet.
errors.INVALID_TRANSITION: That step isn't possible any more. The list has been refreshed.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.NETWORK: The server can't be reached. Check the connection and try again.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is over 10 MB. Choose a smaller file.
errors.FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: Only PDF, JPEG or PNG files can be sent.
errors.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The assistant is unavailable right now. Everything else in Wasla keeps working; try again in a few minutes.
errors.PHONE_TAKEN: This phone number already has an account.

doctor.title: My patients today
doctor.summary: {{waiting}} waiting · {{withMe}} with me · {{done}} done · {{booked}} still to arrive
doctor.finishCurrentFirst: Finish the current visit before calling the next patient.
doctor.queueEmpty: Nobody is waiting in this clinic.
doctor.noVisitBody: Call the next patient, or open a visit from your day to read its notes and results.
doctor.noClinics: You aren't assigned to a clinic yet. Ask your hospital admin to add you to one.

visit.label: Visit
visit.finishNoNotesBody: No notes are saved for this visit, so the patient's summary stays empty until you add some.

notes.clinicalHelp: For you and other doctors. The patient never sees these.
notes.summaryHelp: Plain words. The patient sees this once the visit is finished.
notes.draftRestored: Your unsaved draft from this browser was restored.
notes.conflict: Someone saved these notes after you opened them. Their version is loaded below your draft; copy what you need, then save again.

tests.none: No tests ordered for this visit.
tests.onlyDuringVisit: Tests can be ordered while the patient is with you.
tests.releaseConfirmBody: {{name}} will be able to see and download {{test}} in the Wasla app. This can't be undone.

lab.title: Lab worklist
lab.emptyToStart: Nothing to start. New orders appear here as doctors place them.
lab.emptySent: No results are waiting for a doctor.
lab.selectBody: Pick a test from the list to start it or send its result to the doctor.
lab.dropHere: Drop the result file here, or
lab.fileRules: PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 10 MB.
lab.wrongType: {{file}} isn't a PDF, JPEG or PNG. Choose another file.
lab.tooLarge: {{file}} is {{size}}. Results can be at most 10 MB.
lab.sent: {{test}} for {{name}} was sent to the doctor.
lab.replaceHint: Until the doctor releases it, you can replace the file.
lab.noClinics: You aren't assigned to a lab or radiology clinic yet. Ask your hospital admin.

chat.title: Hospital information assistant
chat.intro: Ask about opening hours, departments, locations, booking rules and other hospital information. Answers come only from the approved hospital information, with their sources. It doesn't answer medical questions or share patient data.
suggestions: What should patients bring to their first appointment?
How far ahead can patients book an appointment?
chat.label: Your question
chat.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
chat.tooLong: Questions can be at most {{max}} characters.
chat.noInformation: The assistant doesn't have that information. It only answers from the approved hospital information, so it won't guess.
chat.unavailable: The assistant is unavailable right now. Everything else in Wasla keeps working; try again in a few minutes.

notAllowed.title: You can't open this page
notAllowed.body: It's for staff with the {{role}} role, and your account doesn't have it. If you need it, ask your hospital admin.

staffRoleHints.RECEPTIONIST: Checks patients in and watches the queue in their clinics.
staffRoleHints.DOCTOR: Sees patients, writes visit notes, orders tests and releases results.
staffRoleHints.LAB: Processes tests and uploads result files in their clinics.
staffRoleHints.ADMIN: Manages staff, hospital setup and statistics. Never sees medical records.

staff.title: Staff
staff.intro: Everyone who logs in to the staff website. Add people, set what they can do, and turn accounts off when someone leaves.
staff.loadFailed: The staff list couldn't be loaded.
staff.cantDeactivateSelf: You can't deactivate your own account.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.loggedOut: They will be logged out immediately, on every device.
deactivate.body: They can't log in again until an admin reactivates them. Their past work keeps their name.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {{name}}?
reactivate.body: They can log in again straight away, with the password they had.

form.name: Full name
form.phoneHint: They log in with this number, e.g. 010 1234 5678
form.phoneInvalid: Enter an Egyptian mobile number, e.g. 010 1234 5678.
form.cantDropOwnAdmin: You can't remove your own admin role.
form.passwordNote: Wasla makes a temporary password for them. You'll see it once, on the next screen.
form.rolesNote: The change applies from their next click; they stay logged in.

created.title: {{name}} can now log in
created.body: Give them this temporary password in person. They log in with their mobile number and this password.
created.once: This is the only time the password is shown. Copy it or write it down before you close this.

hospital.title: Departments & clinics
hospital.intro: Where patients can book and who works where. Changes here show in the patient app and on every staff screen.
hospital.noDepartments: No departments yet. Add the first one to start setting up clinics.
hospital.departmentInactiveNote: This department is inactive: patients can't book it or any of its clinics. Booked and past appointments still show it.
hospital.noClinics: No clinics in this department yet.
hospital.notBookableDepartment: Not bookable while the department is inactive
hospital.noOneToAssign: No active doctors, receptionists or lab staff left to assign.
hospital.assignNote: They will see this clinic’s appointments, queue and tests from their next refresh.
hospital.noDoctors: No active doctor is assigned, so patients have no one to book with here.
hospital.keepsPast: Booked and past appointments keep it, so patients and staff still see where they were.

deactivateDepartment.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivateDepartment.body: It and all its clinics will no longer be bookable.

reactivateDepartment.title: Reactivate {{name}}?
reactivateDepartment.body: Its active clinics become bookable again. Clinics you deactivated one by one stay inactive.

deactivateClinic.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivateClinic.body: It will no longer be bookable.

reactivateClinic.title: Reactivate {{name}}?
reactivateClinic.departmentInactive: It stays unbookable until its department is reactivated too.

unassign.label: Remove {{name}}
unassign.title: Remove {{name}} from {{clinic}}?
unassign.body: They will stop seeing this clinic's appointments and queue. Appointments already booked with them stay as they are.

form.kindHint: Clinical departments take bookings; lab and radiology receive doctors' test orders. It can't be changed later.
form.name: Name
form.editNote: Patients see the new details next time they open the app. Booked appointments stay in this clinic.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.intro: How the clinics ran, day by day. Counts and averages only: no patient is ever named here.
stats.rangeIncomplete: Choose both a start and an end day.
stats.rangeBackwards: The start day is after the end day.
stats.noData: There were no appointments to measure in this range.
stats.keyboardHint: Use the arrow keys to read each day.

visits.title: Visits
visits.definition: Completed visits per day, by department.

wait.title: Average wait
wait.definition: From check-in to the consultation starting.

noShow.title: No-show rate
noShow.definition: Booked patients who didn't come, out of all appointments due (cancelled ones left out).

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every sign-in, booking, record access and admin change, newest first. Nothing here can be edited or deleted, and entries carry no medical content or passwords.
audit.backwards: The start day is after the end day.
audit.loadFailed: The audit log couldn't be loaded.
